works.title: Industrial Policy Reference Series
works.description: A comprehensive series of standalone reference reports on industrial policy topics, with part 2 focused on the Inflation Reduction Act's energy and climate provisions (2022–2026). Covers fiscal scale, implementation mechanisms, and distributional effects.

works.title: Oracle User Data Encryption Architecture
works.description: A technical design for an encrypted chat-storage system within the Oracle project, where user data is encrypted with user-specific keys to eliminate single-point-of-failure vulnerabilities in credential-based access.
works.quote: I want to create users whose information would be encrypted such that only they have the encryption key
